$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: V1 fallback when the server does not accept v2
summary: A conforming v1 server ignores the unknown protocol_v2_offer text message and continues in v1 mode. The phone MUST continue to accept valid v1 results unless and until it receives a valid v2 acceptance for the current connection. The offer is ignored, not an error.

steps.note: Offer is sent; a v1 server treats it as an unknown text-message type and ignores it. (PROTOCOL.md: unknown text types MUST be ignored; PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1)
The server continues rendering v1 results. The phone continues accepting valid v1 results. No v2 acceptance is ever sent. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1)

outcome: Both sides remain in v1 mode. The phone renders v1 results under the lossy v1 fallback projection. No protocol error is emitted for the ignored offer.
